purpose: Canonical rejection reasons for adversarial V2 federation pressure tests.

rejection_reasons.LATEST_EPOCH_AMBIGUITY: Query or compact references latest/current epoch instead of explicit root-bound epoch.
rejection_reasons.UNPROVABLE_OBLIGATION_MET: Artifact attempts to write obligation_met or compliance verdict instead of attestation presence.
rejection_reasons.UNPROVABLE_DEONTIC_STATE: Artifact attempts to derive must/shall/penalty state from predicate proof without local sovereign replay.
rejection_reasons.PRIVILEGED_INTERPRETER_ATTEMPT: Artifact requires federation to interpret substantive meaning beyond deterministic proof verification.
rejection_reasons.PROOF_BOUNDS_EXCEEDED: Proof material exceeds bounded predicate or attestation limits.
rejection_reasons.RAW_UNBOUNDED_EVIDENCE: Artifact embeds unbounded raw evidence instead of typed hashed proof reference.
rejection_reasons.FEDERATION_ENFORCEMENT_ATTEMPT: Artifact attempts to make federation enforce, command, or adjudicate rather than attest.
rejection_reasons.COMPACT_BASELINE_MUTATION_ATTEMPT: Compact attempts to mutate or rewrite participant state baselines.

invariants: Every adversarial rejection must resolve to a named reason code.
No rejection may require narrative discretion.
Failure codes are part of replay output, not commentary.
